description: Fastify is a Node.js web framework with useful tools for route schemas, plugins and request tests. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.
versionNote: Examples use Fastify 5 and Node.js 20 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Read a query string with Fastify
Run a step before a handler with Fastify
learningObjectives: Read a JSON body with Fastify
Group routes in a plugin with Fastify
